name: ZELAN
recent: ZELAN 近期持续发布 PN17 每月公告，处于财务困境重组阶段；最新季度业绩截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日已公布。公司同时更换了公司秘书。
notable: 公司秘书由 JAMALIA SHERIDAN BINTI KHOTIB 接任。
risks: 公司处于 PN17 财务困境类别，需按月公告重组进展。

recent_en: ZELAN has continued issuing monthly PN17 announcements while in its financial distress restructuring phase; its latest quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 have been released. The company also changed its company secretary.
notable_en: Company secretary changed to JAMALIA SHERIDAN BINTI KHOTIB.
risks_en: The company is under PN17 financial distress classification and must announce restructuring progress monthly.
